Q: Thank you for agreeing to give this recorded statement. Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just be identified as the passenger in the vehicle, if that's alright.
Q: That works for the file. Where were you sitting when the collision occurred?
A: In the front passenger seat of my friend's sedan.
Q: Can you describe what the driver was doing before impact?
A: We were stopped at a red light on Highway 6 in Sugar Land, waiting to turn. Traffic was moving slowly and we'd
come to a complete stop.
Q: Did you see the other vehicle approaching?
A: Not really. I was looking at my phone. The first thing I noticed was a loud bang from behind and my body jerking
forward and then back.
Q: What part of your body was injured?
A: My right wrist. I put my hand out to brace myself against the dashboard and I felt something snap right away.
Q: Did you seek medical attention?
A: Yes, the paramedics checked me at the scene, and then I went to an urgent care clinic later that evening. They
took X-rays and said the wrist was fractured. I've since been referred to an orthopedic specialist.
Q: Are you currently receiving treatment?
A: I have a splint now and I'm scheduled for a follow-up. I can't work my usual job right now because I use my hands
a lot.
Q: Did you experience any other symptoms, such as neck or back pain?
A: My neck feels stiff and sore, and my shoulder aches on the same side, but the wrist is the worst of it.
Q: Is there anything you would like to add to your statement?
A: Only that I was not at fault in any way. We were just sitting at the light when we got hit.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
A: Okay, thank you.
</page>
